input.title: ZM3D playable - brief for PlayableX
input.bodyText:
ZM3D playable - brief for PlayableX
Zombie Match 3D (Puzzles vs Zombies) playable ad. Written 1 Oct 2025 for the game as it is today. If the core gameplay changes before the start, we'll redo the affected parts with you in November.

Start date
Kickoff is Monday 3 November 2025. Every file still owed from us is listed on the hand-off list (linked below), with who has it.

Scenario
We picked Scenario 1. It follows the core game: the player taps any items they like off the pile and keeps matching for as long as they can. It's built to keep retention up. It should filter out players who won't enjoy the real game, rather than chase the cheapest install with a casual playable that has nothing to do with it. It isn't on rails. A good player can make several matches before the end card.

How a level plays
- Items sit in a 3D physics pile and partly cover each other. The player taps an item to send it to the tray.
- The tray has 7 slots. Any 3 matching items in the tray clear, and each cleared set fires at the zombies. Different items hit differently, for example the Grenade is powerful, the Couch does splash damage and the plush toys are weak but funny.
- Zombies walk toward the player across the top of the screen.
- Win: every zombie on screen is eliminated.
- Lose: the zombies reach the player and the player's HP runs out. That is the only way to lose.
- If all 7 tray slots fill without a match, that's a blunder, not a loss. The tray clears, the surviving zombies enrage, and play continues.
- The rocket launcher in the reference level is our Cannon, with its projectile in the same file. The "duck" in the reference video is the Plushie Chick.
- Reference: the reference level (deck "ZM3D playable - reference level") and the recording Brian sent on 24 Sep. Background: the background of that reference level.

Board: the 8 items
Grenade, Couch, Plushie Chick, Shuriken, Cute Axe, Gift Box, Cactus Plant, Bow.
The Bow replaces the Dynamite from the earlier list (Robert, 26 Sep). The arrow may become its own item later. For now the Bow goes on the board as it is.
Every other board item on the hand-off list (Board set = Extra, Dynamite included) is an extra you can swap in to test.

Zombies
Four characters: Party Girl, Plumber, Magician, Football Player. All four are in the Unity package Brian sent on 26 Sep.
One animation: walk. Please re-rig these four in Spine with the walk animation only.

Sound
We only send sound that is ours to give you.
- Ours and on the list: matching sound, success sound, failure sound.
- Coming from us: our own rocket sound and explosion sound. The ones in the game come from a sound library and a bought pack, so they stay with us until our own versions are made. Please don't source or reuse the in-game ones.
- Music: a new track made for the ad, not the in-game track. It's being cut down to a loop.
- Music starts only after the player's first tap. That's your rule from the Domino Delights playable, and it still holds. Sound effects can play from the first interaction.

Formats (as you told us, still holds)
- 3D: .fbx (binary, not ASCII), .glb or .blend
- 2D: .png (for 2D animation, character parts separated into pieces)
- Font: .ttf or .woff2
- Sound: .mp3 or .wav

What's coming from us
The hand-off list has one row per line of our pack list, with its state. Delivered means you already have the current file. Ready means it's exported, checked and waiting in our outgoing folder. Owed means we still have work to do on it, and the row says what and who has it.
Hand-off list: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/17wsx5pqticIBzJS9i2GmzeHb9Srj7c59lLdTNOISdGQ/edit

Contacts
Frederick Stone (overall), Julia Lawson (brief and design), Brian Foster (files), Robert (board and zombie picks).

text:
Done. The brief and the hand-off list are both in my Drive, shared view-only with you, Brian, Robert and PlayableX intake.
• Brief: https://docs.google.com/document/d/200e519b5101e6b5cfe99c0c/edit
• Hand-off list: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/17wsx5pqticIBzJS9i2GmzeHb9Srj7c59lLdTNOISdGQ/edit

Counts across Brian's 96 lines:
• *Delivered: 8*
• *Ready: 36*
• *Owed: 52* (Brian 27, Claire 21, Calvin 3, Martin 1)

Several lines have changed since Brian's notes:
• The 12 models Brian saved out of Unity on 25 Sep are ASCII FBX (Marcus, 26 Sep). PlayableX only take binary, so all 12 go back to Brian.
• Claire is redoing the UVs on the 12 bathroom items. Her 26 Sep files are the old versions.
• The 8 music instruments: the zip was cut off on upload (Brian, 30 Sep).
• Chainsaw, Cone and Cactus Plant have new colour versions (Robert, 29 Sep), so they need re-exporting.
• The rocket and explosion sounds come from a library and a bought pack, so they stay with us until Calvin makes our own.
• Robert swapped the Bow into the board 8 in place of the Dynamite. The Board 8 now stands at 3 Delivered, 4 Ready and 1 Owed (Cactus Plant, with Claire).

The 52 Owed tickets under DES-313 are in Todo, each with a comment saying what's owed and who has it. I'm posting both links in the PlayableX channel now.

Hi <@PERSON_6078_SLACK_ID>, ahead of the 3 November kickoff, here's what you'll build from and what's still coming from us. Both links are view-only and also shared with your intake address.
• *Brief:* https://docs.google.com/document/d/200e519b5101e6b5cfe99c0c/edit
It covers Scenario 1, the 8 board items (every other board item is an extra you can swap in), the 4 zombies (Party Girl, Plumber, Magician, Football Player) with the walk animation only, the win/lose rules and the 7-slot tray, the sound, and music starting after the first tap.
• *Hand-off list:* https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/17wsx5pqticIBzJS9i2GmzeHb9Srj7c59lLdTNOISdGQ/edit
It has one row per asset with its state. Delivered means you already have it. Ready means it's checked and waiting in our outgoing folder. Owed means it's still coming from us, and the row says what's missing.

Right now: 8 delivered, 36 ready and 52 still owed. It's written for the game as it is today. If the core gameplay changes, we'll go over the affected parts with you in November.
